name: The Legend of Ogorets #1: Wrat
source:
#1 is the adventure of Wrat, a desperate soul-searcher consumed by worry and driven by guilt as he realizes he’s never met his son, by now a grown man in a world of cutthroats, murderers, and bloodthirsty mercenaries.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2498350/]Steam[/url]]
